intent.description: Governed first-domain launch for a project with no formal production domain, or only a provider URL such as pages.dev or vercel.app. Use when Nemo asks to deploy or bind a Spaceship domain through Cloudflare DNS using exactly one route: static_pages for Cloudflare Pages, or saas_vercel for Vercel-hosted SaaS/SSR. Deploys the selected provider target, verifies Cloudflare authoritative DNS, TLS and public routes, then idempotently writes the verified formal domain to project-root AGENTS.md. Do not trigger when the project already has a formal production domain, for domain purchase only, Vercel-only hosting without Cloudflare DNS, GitHub Pages, Git push, GSC/GA/ads, wildcard Vercel domains, arbitrary DNS deletion, credential extraction, or generic deployment advice.
intent.job_to_be_done: Give a project that does not yet have a formal production domain one of two governed launch routes: Spaceship to Cloudflare DNS and Cloudflare Pages for a static site, or Spaceship to Cloudflare DNS and Vercel for a SaaS application; prove the public domain works, then record it idempotently in the project-root AGENTS.md.
inputs: project directory and evidence that no formal production domain is configured
mode-specific Pages or Vercel project target
Spaceship domain, Cloudflare zone, and exact authorized mutations
production HTTPS origin and representative public paths
outputs: formal-domain absence and deployment-mode decision evidence
Pages or Vercel deployment evidence with the other route marked not_required
Cloudflare DNS and Spaceship mutation ledger with rollback snapshots
public DNS, TLS, route, and mode-appropriate content verification
exclusions: projects that already have a formal production domain
Vercel-only deployment without Spaceship and Cloudflare authoritative DNS
Vercel wildcard domains while Cloudflare remains authoritative DNS
Git push, GSC, GA, ads, or game-site pipeline state

SaaS 没有 custom domain；从 Vercel 项目读取精确 DNS 值，写到 Cloudflare 并验证 HTTPS。

compact_workflow: **建立事实基线。** 记录 Git revision/dirty state、现有 provider 默认 URL、正式域名缺失证据、Cloudflare zone/DNS、公共 NS/DS 和 Spaceship 当前设置。创建脱敏 launch report，保存每个动作的授权、执行、回读和 rollback snapshot。

**运行项目原生验证。** 两种 mode 都先跑现有 build/check/test。`static_pages` 必须以最终 `production_origin` 重建输出，再运行 `scripts/preflight.py` 检查首页、代表性内页、canonical、robots 和 sitemap；不得部署旧产物。`saas_vercel` 按项目现有 Vercel 配置验证 build、env 名称和代表性流程，不读取或记录 secret value。
**验证身份和精确目标。** 复用已验证的 Cloudflare Wrangler OAuth/API 环境和 Vercel CLI/dashboard 会话，只读确认 account、project、zone 和 domain target。OAuth callback、token、Cookie、验证码、环境变量值和浏览器存储不得进入聊天、命令回显、报告或 fixture。

**执行唯一 hosting route。** `static_pages` 部署已验证的静态目录，记录 deployment ID、environment、source revision、终态和 `pages.dev` HTTPS 回读。`saas_vercel` 发布或复用精确 production deployment，记录 deployment ID/URL、READY 终态、source revision 和 `vercel.app` HTTPS 回读；优先复用同一已验证 artifact，不用重建掩盖问题。
**准备 Cloudflare authoritative DNS。** 创建或读取精确 zone，取得该 zone 实际分配的两台 nameserver；快照 Cloudflare 导入记录、Spaceship DNS、当前 NS 和父区 DS。Pages/Vercel binding、DNS record、NS 和 DNSSEC 是独立动作。

**绑定正式域名。** `static_pages` 必须先在 Pages 项目添加 custom domain，再依 provider 结果处理 DNS；只手工建 CNAME 可能产生 522。`saas_vercel` 必须先在目标 Vercel 项目添加 domain，再逐项复制该项目当前 Domain Settings 返回的 A/CNAME/TXT/verification 值到 Cloudflare；不得硬编码通用 target。Vercel 承载记录与第三方验证记录在验收阶段保持 DNS-only；启用 Cloudflare proxy 是上线后的独立 mutation。
**最小化切换。** 只删除“按 ID、类型、名称、内容精确匹配，已确认是停放记录，且确实阻塞目标”的记录，并保留可恢复快照。MX、TXT、CAA、邮件和验证记录默认保留。先正确处理旧 DNSSEC，再在 Spaceship 切到 Cloudflare 实际 nameservers，等待 zone Active。
**完成 DNSSEC（如在范围内）。** 普通迁移先移除旧 DS，等待父区 DS TTL 到期且公开查询为空，再切 NS。Cloudflare zone Active 后启用 signing，读取新 DS，再写入 Spaceship。至少两个验证递归解析器返回 `ad` 才能声明完成。未请求时整组动作写一致的 `not_required`。

**证明 `domain_ready`。** 回读 hosting provider 的 deployment/domain/certificate，运行 `scripts/verify_public.py` 检查 Cloudflare NS、目标 DNS、正式 HTTPS、TLS、根路径与代表性路径；按 mode 检查 SEO 文件。最后用 `scripts/validate_launch_report.py --require-domain-ready` 校验证据。
**写回并证明 `launch_complete`。** 仅在 `domain_ready=true` 后运行 `scripts/update_agents_domain.py`。它保留已有内容，缺文件时创建，只维护一个 `nemo-domain-launch` block，重复运行不追加；写后立即回读并更新 report。再用 `--require-launch-complete` 验证。
gate_ladder: `scope_locked`：项目、mode、origin、domain、provider targets、registrar 和授权动作明确。
`local_verified`：项目原生 build/check 通过；静态 mode 的正式 origin 产物预检通过。
`hosting_deployed`：唯一 hosting action 终态和 provider 默认 URL 回读通过；另一 action 为一致 `not_required`。
`zone_staged`：Cloudflare zone、目标 NS、DNS/DS 快照和 rollback 已记录。
`nameservers_cut_over`：父区公开 NS 与 Cloudflare 分配值一致，旧 DS 已按路径处理。
`custom_domain_active`：Pages 或 Vercel binding、hosting DNS、certificate 和正式域 HTTPS 均通过。
`dnssec_active`：请求时要求 Cloudflare signing、父区 DS 和两个 resolver 的 `ad`；否则为 `not_required`。
`domain_ready`：mode 对应 provider、公共 DNS、TLS、根路径和代表性路径满足契约，`missing_evidence` 为空。
`agents_md_recorded`：项目根 `AGENTS.md` 的受管块精确回读成功。
output_contract: `scope`：项目、mode、正式域名缺失证据、build/output、origin、Pages/Vercel project、domain、registrar、source revision。
`actions`：七个动作分别记录 authorization、execution、readback、before 和 rollback；非当前 hosting route 为一致 `not_required`。
`observations.provider`：Pages/Vercel deployment、Cloudflare zone、custom domain、certificate、hosting DNS、DNSSEC 分开记录。
`observations.public_dns`：至少两个 resolver 的 NS、DS、A/AAAA/CNAME、hosting target 一致性与 DNSSEC `ad`。
`observations.public_http`：provider 默认 URL、正式根路径、代表性路径、TLS，以及 mode 适用的 canonical/robots/sitemap。
`observations.agents_md`：只记录状态、项目根路径和 managed block 名。
`claims`：`domain_ready`、`launch_complete`、`dnssec_complete` 都必须由 validator 证明。
`rollback`：DNS snapshot、旧 NS/DS、Pages/Vercel 上一个可用 deployment、最后安全检查点。

execution.shell: python3 plus project-native commands, current Wrangler or Vercel CLI, and read-only DNS/HTTP tools

trust.source_tier: local governed package; mutable Cloudflare, Vercel, and Spaceship facts require current official or live-provider evidence
trust.credential_policy: secret values never enter prompts, reports, fixtures, command output, AGENTS.md, or shell persistence

permissions.network: only exact Cloudflare, Vercel, Spaceship, public DNS resolver, and site resources in the locked scope
permissions.file_write: project-native build artifacts, an explicit launch report, and the managed production-domain block in project-root AGENTS.md after domain_ready
permissions.subprocess: project-native build/check, current Wrangler or Vercel CLI, package scripts, dig/curl/openssl, and bundled validators
permissions.live_mutation: only exact user-authorized mode-specific deploy, custom-domain, DNS-record, nameserver, DNSSEC, and final AGENTS.md writeback actions
permissions.interactive: allowed for OAuth, registrar, 2FA, or dashboard steps; never inspect browser storage or copy callbacks

degradation.formal_domain_unresolved: continue read-only discovery; do not mutate until absence or provider-default-only status is proven
degradation.formal_domain_present: do not activate this launch workflow; route maintenance or migration elsewhere
degradation.no_cloudflare_write_access: produce local verification, inventory, mutation plan, rollback snapshot, and missing-evidence report
degradation.no_vercel_access: in saas_vercel mode stop before deployment/domain binding and preserve read-only evidence
degradation.no_registrar_access: keep hosting deployment evidence and stop before nameserver or DS mutation
degradation.no_browser: prefer CLI/API and emit a precise handoff for provider-only steps
degradation.no_dig: use at least two named public DNS APIs; local resolver output alone is insufficient

governed: formal_domain_before is proven absent or provider_default_only
exactly one deployment mode is selected and the other hosting action is coherently not_required
Cloudflare Pages custom domain is bound before relying on its DNS record
Vercel DNS values come from the current project Domain Settings and remain DNS-only during acceptance
provider status, public DNS, public HTTPS, and local cache are separate evidence channels
DNS changes have exact before snapshots and rollback actions
old DS is removed and expired before ordinary nameserver migration
new DNSSEC requires Cloudflare signing, parent DS, and two validating resolver AD results
token, OAuth code, callback URL, Cookie, password, private key, and browser storage are prohibited
AGENTS.md writeback occurs only after domain_ready and is read back idempotently
launch_complete requires both domain_ready and AGENTS.md writeback
provider-backed or human-review evidence is labeled missing until actually recorded

evidence_boundary.public_claim_policy: claim only what local validation, install proof, human review, or provider-backed evidence actually supports
